blocks.text: Podon mein nashonuma (growth) jasamat (size) mein mustaqil izafa hai, jo oonchai, chaurai aur kamiyat (mass) mein ho sakta hai. Poda apni poori zindagi shakhon, patton aur jaron jaise aza (organs) ka izafa karta rehta hai; us ke aza apne siron se barhte hain, magar nashonuma ki raftar poore jism mein yaksan nahin hoti. Nichle podon mein poora jism barh sakta hai, magar oonche podon mein nashonuma barhne ke nuqton (growing points) tak mehdood hai, yani cells ke woh giroh jo musalsal taqseem (division) ki salahiyat rakhte hain, jinhen meristems kehte hain.

items: Apical meristems jaron aur shakhon (shoots) ke siron par hote hain aur pode ke jism ki lambai barhane ke bunyadi zimmedar hain. Yeh musalsal nashonuma ke ilaqe hain jo jaron aur tanon ke siron par cells ki tadaad barhate hain, aur primary growth mein kaleedi kirdar ada karte hain.

Intercalary meristems mustaqil tissues se sire (apex) se alag hote hain. Yeh ghaas jaise bohat se podon mein internodes ki bunyad par hote hain, patte aur phool banane mein aham hissa lete hain, aur aarzi hain.

Lateral meristems kinare ke saath taqseem hone wale cells ke cylinders hain, jo tanon aur jaron ki motai mein nashonuma ke zimmedar hain. Lakri wale (woody) podon mein paye jate hain, secondary growth ke liye nihayat aham hain aur do shaklon mein hote hain: vascular cambium, xylem aur phloem ke darmiyan, jo secondary xylem aur secondary phloem banata hai; aur cork cambium, tanon aur jaron ki bairooni tah mein, jo cork cells banata hai jo epidermis ki jagah lete aur hifazati bairooni chhaal (bark) banate hain.

blocks.alt: Ek naujawan pauda jis par lateral bud hai; teer shoot ke sire, tane aur jar ke sire se teen bare dabbon tak jate hain: shoot ka sira; tana khol kar Cork cambium aur Vascular cambium; aur jar ka sira jis mein shakh, Root hairs, Root apical meristem aur Root cap. Daen taraf shoot ke sire ka section (Leaf primordia, Lateral bud primordia; paimana 100 micrometre) aur jar ke sire ka section (Root apical meristem, Root cap; paimana 50 micrometre).
blocks.caption: Figure 8.12: Apical meristem pode ka primary jism aur lateral meristem secondary jism banata hai (kitab ki Figure 8.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Siron (apex) par apical meristems hain jo pode ko lamba karte hain: yeh primary jism hai. Tane ke andar ke cambium (vascular aur cork) lateral meristems hain jo tane ko mota karte hain: yeh secondary jism hai. Leaf primordia aur lateral bud primordia aage chal kar naye patte aur shakhein bante hain.

Primary growth pode ki lambai barhati hai aur apical meristems se hoti hai. Herbaceous pode aam taur par woody podon ke muqable mein primary growth dikhate hain aur secondary growth kam. Primary growth teen marhalon (phases) mein hoti hai.

items: Cell division (taqseem): apical meristems ke cells taqseem hote hain aur cells ki tadaad barhti hai, jar aur shoot ke siron par. Cell division ke is zone mein chhote, be-vacuole cells hote hain jin ke gol nuclei cytoplasm ke markaz mein hote hain.

Cell elongation (lambai): naye cells pani le kar hajm mein barhte hain; cell wall ki lachak (plasticity) barhti aur deewar ka dabao kam hota hai. Yeh siron se thora peeche, cell elongation ke zone mein hota hai, jahan cells vacuole wale aur bare hain aur un ke nuclei cytoplasm ke kinare par hain. Apni aakhri jasamat tak pohnchne ke liye mukhtalif cells mukhtalif simton mein lambe hote hain: jo pith ya cortex banne wale hain woh lambai mein zyada nahin barhte, jab ke xylem banne wale bohat zyada lambe hote hain.

Cell differentiation (takhsees): jab cells apni aakhri jasamat aur shakal pa lete hain to lambai rukti hai aur woh khaas kaamon ke liye makhsoos ho jate hain; un ki deewarein moti hoti aur nai banawati khusoosiyat paida hoti hain. Yeh elongation ke zone ke saath, cell differentiation ke zone mein hota hai, jahan har qism ka cell apna khaas kaam karta hai.

blocks.alt: Jar ke sire ka lambai mein section. Rangeen patti sire se upar ki taraf Zone of Division (neela), Zone of Elongation (hara) aur Zone of Differentiation (narangi) dikhati hai. Andar beech mein neela Xylem aur us ke pehlu mein Phloem, un ke gird Pericycle aur Endodermis, phir Cortex aur Epidermis; Root hairs sirf zone of differentiation mein. Sire par Apical meristem pyale-numa Root cap ke peeche.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.13: Jar mein primary growth (kitab ki Figure 8.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neeche se upar parhein: sire ke paas cells taqseem hote hain (division), un ke upar lambe hote hain (elongation), aur phir khaas tissues mein badalte hain (differentiation). Root hairs isi aakhri zone mein nikalte hain. Root cap meristem ko mitti mein ragar se bachata hai.

Secondary growth tanon aur jaron ki motai ya gherai (girth) mein izafa hai, jo lateral meristems, vascular cambium aur cork cambium, se hota hai. Yeh woody kaseer-sala (perennial) podon mein zyada numayan hai; herbaceous pode sirf primary growth dikhate hain. Vascular cambium ke cells taqseem ho kar apne bairooni aur andarooni dono kinaron par naye cells banate hain: bairooni cells secondary phloem aur andarooni cells secondary xylem banate hain, aur yeh secondary tissues, khaas kar secondary xylem, pode ki motai barhate hain. Cork cambium mein taqseem bhi dono taraf cells banati hai, jo naya cork banate hain. Pakke tane ka vascular cambium se bahar ka ilaqa, jis mein secondary phloem, cork cambium aur cork hain, majmui taur par bark hai.

blocks.alt: Ek pauda Shoot system aur Root system ke brackets ke saath: Shoot tip (shoot apical meristem aur naujawan patte), Axillary bud meristem, Lateral growth meristems aur Root apical meristems. Teer do tane ki tikiyon (discs) tak jate hain. Upar wali (Apical meristems increase height): Epidermis, Primary phloem, Primary xylem, Vascular cambium.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.14: Pode mein primary aur secondary growth (kitab ki Figure 8.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Ek pauda Shoot system aur Root system ke brackets ke saath: Shoot tip (shoot apical meristem aur naujawan patte), Axillary bud meristem, Lateral growth meristems aur Root apical meristems. Teer do tane ki tikiyon (discs) tak jate hain. Upar wali (Apical meristems increase height): Epidermis, Primary phloem, Primary xylem, Vascular cambium. Neeche wali chauri (Lateral meristems increase girth): Primary phloem, Secondary phloem, Vascular cambium, Primary xylem, Secondary xylem, aur bahar Cork cambium.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono tikiyon ka muqabla karein. Upar wali sirf primary tissues rakhti hai. Neeche wali mein vascular cambium ne andar ki taraf secondary xylem aur bahar ki taraf secondary phloem banaya hai, is liye tana mota ho gaya; sab se bahar cork cambium cork bana kar chhaal (bark) banata hai.

Annual rings darakhton mein cambium ki mausami sargarmi se bante hain, jis par mahol ke awamil asar dalte hain, aur har saal do alag qism ki lakri dete hain: bahar ki lakri (spring wood ya early wood) aur khizan ki lakri (autumn wood ya late wood). Cambium ek meristematic tissue hai jo naya xylem aur phloem banata hai. Bahar mein, jab halaat mawafiq hon, yeh bohat faal hota hai aur chaure vessels wala zyada xylem banata hai, yani halki spring wood. Khizan aate aate is ki sargarmi girti hai aur yeh kam, tang aur ghane xylem elements banata hai, yani gehri autumn wood. Spring wood aur autumn wood mil kar ek annual ring banate hain, aur har saal naya ring jurta hai, is liye darakht ki umr dendrochronology se maloom ki ja sakti hai. Spring se autumn wood ki taraf tabdeeli batadreej hoti hai, magar autumn se agli spring ki taraf achanak, jo nashonuma ke daur ko saaf nishan zad karti hai; is liye halqe darakht ki umr aur har mausam-e-nashonuma ke halaat record karte hain, jo tawil-muddati aab-o-hawa (climate) ki tabdeeli ke mutale ke liye qeemti hai.

blocks.alt: Kata hua tana jis se ek tikona tukra nikala gaya hai. Upar ki transverse satah par beech mein pith, gehri heartwood, halki sapwood aur bohat se growth rings, gird inner bark aur kali outer bark. Nikale gaye tukre ki deewarein radial surface (seedhi lakeerein) aur saamne chhaal hata kar tangential surface (mure hue namoone). Labels: sapwood, heartwood, pith, growth rings, transverse surface, radial surface, inner bark, outer bark, tangential surface.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.15: Darakht ke tane ki banawat, annual rings ke saath (kitab ki Figure 8.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har saal cambium ek halka (spring wood) aur ek gehra (autumn wood) hissa banata hai; dono mil kar ek annual ring hain, is liye rings gin kar darakht ki umr maloom hoti hai. Beech ki gehri heartwood purani aur sakht hai, bahar ki halki sapwood abhi pani le jati hai.

blocks.title: Dendrochronology
blocks.text: Guzashta aab-o-hawa ke halaat aur waqiat ka tajziya karne ke liye darakht ke halqon ki tareekh maloom karne aur un ke mutale ka sciencei tareeqa.

Pode apne cells mein nashonuma aur metabolism ki raftar khaas kimiyai qasidon (chemical messengers) se qaboo karte hain, jinhen plant growth regulators ya plant hormones kehte hain. Paanch bare giroh hain: auxins, cytokinins, gibberellins, abscisic acid aur ethylene.

items: Auxins indole acetic acid (IAA) aur us ki shaklein hain. Tane mein yeh sire ke peeche ke ilaqe mein cell ke barhne aur cambium mein cell division ko barhate hain; jar mein bohat kam concentration par nashonuma barhate magar zyada par rokte hain (jaise geotropism mein), aur qalmon (cuttings) aur calluses se jaron ki nashonuma barhate hain. Yeh shoots mein kali (bud) ki ibtida barhate hain (agarche kabhi rokte bhi hain, cytokinins ki mukhalifat mein), apical dominance aur phal ki nashonuma barhate hain, parthenocarpy paida kar sakte hain, chand aqsam mein patte ke burhape (senescence) mein takheer karte hain, aur abscission rokte hain.

Gibberellins jaron aur shoots ke sire ke hisson mein bante aur doosri jagah le jaye jate hain; in mein gibberellic acid hai aur 110 se zyada qismein maloom hain. Yeh auxins ki maujoodgi mein cell ke barhne aur apical meristem aur cambium mein cell division ko barhate hain, kuch rosette podon ka bolting, chrysanthemum callus mein kali ki ibtida, patte aur phal ki nashonuma (aur parthenocarpy paida kar sakte hain), apical dominance mein auxins ke amal ko barhate hain, kali aur beej ki khwabidgi (dormancy) torte hain, surkh roshni ka badal ban sakte hain (yun long-day podon mein phool barhate aur short-day podon mein rokte hain), aur chand aqsam mein patte ke senescence mein takheer karte hain.

Cytokinins aam taur par jaron, naujawan phalon aur beejon mein bante hain. Yeh cell division mein cytokinesis barhate aur DNA replication aur RNA aur protein synthesis ki raftar barhate hain. Yeh apical meristem aur cambium mein cell division se tane ki nashonuma barhate, primary jar ki nashonuma rokte magar lateral jaron ki barhate, kali ki ibtida aur patte ki nashonuma barhate, phal ki nashonuma barhate (shaz-o-nadir parthenocarpy), lateral kaliyon ki nashonuma barhate aur kali ki dormancy torte, patte ke senescence mein takheer karte aur stomata ka khulna barhate hain.

Abscisic acid (ABA) zyada tar pakke sabz patton, phalon aur root caps mein banta hai. Yeh tane aur jar ki nashonuma rokta hai, khaas kar khushk-sali (drought) aur pani bharne (waterlogging) jaise tabee dabao mein, kali aur beej ki dormancy barhata hai, short-day podon mein phool barhata aur long-day podon mein rokta hai (gibberellins ki mukhalifat mein), kabhi patte ka senescence barhata hai, abscission barhata hai, aur pani ke dabao (murjhane) mein stomata ka band hona barhata hai.

Ethylene pode ke metabolism ki qudrati paidawar hai. Yeh tane ki nashonuma rokta hai, khaas kar tabee dabao mein, jar ki nashonuma rokta hai, kali ki dormancy torta hai, ananas (pineapple) mein phool barhata aur phal ka pakna barhata hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek maali chahta hai ke qalmein jarein pakrein, lawn chhota rahe, aur kele pak jayen. Har maqsad mein madad dene wala regulator batayein, aur samjhayein ke shoot ka sira katne se jhari zyada ghani kyun hoti hai.
blocks.explanation: Auxin qalmon se jaron ki nashonuma barhata hai; abscisic acid ya ethylene tane ki nashonuma rokte hain, agarche aam jawab ghaas katna hai; ethylene phal ka pakna barhata hai. Shoot ke sire ka auxin apical dominance qaim rakhta hai, lateral kaliyon ko dabata hai; sira hatane se woh auxin hat jata hai, to cytokinins lateral kaliyon ki nashonuma barha sakte hain aur poda shakhein nikalta hai.

items: Nashonuma meristems par jasamat mein mustaqil izafa hai: apical (sire; lambai mein primary growth), intercalary (ghaas ke internodes ki bunyad; aarzi) aur lateral (vascular cambium aur cork cambium; gherai mein secondary growth).

Primary growth: cell division, elongation (pani lena, deewar ki lachak) aur differentiation ke zones. Secondary growth: vascular cambium bahar secondary phloem aur andar xylem banata hai; cork cambium cork banata hai; phloem, cork cambium aur cork bark banate hain.
Annual rings: har saal chauri halki spring wood aur tang gehri autumn wood; dendrochronology darakhton aur guzashta aab-o-hawa ki tareekh batati hai.
Regulators: auxins (IAA), gibberellins, cytokinins, abscisic acid aur ethylene, har ek nashonuma, dormancy, phool, senescence, abscission, stomata ya pakne ko barhata ya rokta hai.
